senses.gloss: युज् [yuj], I. 7 U. (युनक्ति, युङ्क्ते, युयोज, युयुजे, अयुजत्, अयौक्षीत्, अयुक्त, योक्ष्यति-ते, योक्तुम्, युक्त)
To join, unite, attach, connect, add; तमर्थमिव भारत्या सुतया योक्तुमर्हसि Ku.6.79; see pass. below.
To yoke, harness, put to; भानुः सकृद्युक्ततुरङ्ग एव Ś.5.4; ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ Bg.1.14.
To furnish or endow with; as in गुणयुक्त.
To use, employ, apply; प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते Bg.17.26; Ms.7.24.
To appoint, set (with loc.); प्रजासु वृत्तिं यमयुङ्क्त वेदितुम् Ki.1.1.
To direct, turn or fix upon (as the mind &c.).
To concentrate one's attention upon; मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः Bg.6.14; युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानम् 15.
To put, place or fix on (with loc.).
To prepare, arrange, make ready, fit.
To give, bestow, confer; दध्यक्षताद्भिर्युयुजुः सदाशिषः Bhāg.1.25.29; आशिषं युयुजे.
To adhere or cleave to.
To enjoin, charge; उवाच चैनं मेधावी युङ्क्ष्वात्मानमिति प्रभो Mb.15.37.3.
To put in, insert.
To think or meditate upon. -Pass. (युज्यते)
To be joined or united with; रविपीत- जला तपात्यये पुनरोघेन हि युज्यते नदी Ku.4.44; R.8.17.
To get, be possessed of; इष्टैर्युज्येथाम् Mv.7; इष्टेन युज्यस्व Ś.5; R.3.65.
To be fit or right, be proper, to suit (with loc. or gen.); या यस्य युज्यते भूमिका तां खलु भावेन तथैव सर्वे वर्ग्याः पाठिताः Māl.1; त्रैलोक्यस्यापि प्रभुत्वं त्वयि युज्यते H.1.
To be ready for; ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व Bg.2. 38,5.
To be intent on, be absorbed in, be directed towards; दैवकर्मणि युक्तो हि बिभर्तीदं चराचरम् Ms.3.75;14. 35; Ki.7.13.
To be fastened or harnessed.
To adhere, to be in close contact.
To attain to, possess, obtain.
To be made ready. -Caus. (योजयति-ते)
To join, unite, bring together; परस्परेण स्पृहणीयशोभं न वेदिदं द्वन्द्वमयोजयिष्यत् R.7.14.
To present, give, bestow; चरोरर्धार्धभागाभ्यां तामयोजयतामुभे R.1.56.
To appoint, employ, use; शत्रुभिर्योजयेच्छत्रुम् Pt.4.17.
To turn or direct towards; पापान्निवारयति योजयते हिताय Bh. 2.72.
To excite, urge, instigate.
To perform, achieve.
To prepare, arrange, equip.
To yoke, harness.
To apply, fix, set, place.
To furnish or endow with.
To surround.
To despise, think lightly of.

To appoint to. -Desid. (युयुक्षति-ते) To wish to join, yoke, give &c. -II. 1 P., 1 U. (योजति, योजयति-ते) To unite, join, yoke &c.; see युज् above. -III. 4 Ā. (युज्यते) To concentrate the mind (identical with the pass. of युज् I). -IV. 1 Ā. (योजयते) To censure.
युज् [yuj], a. (At the end of comp.)
Joined or united with, yoked, drawn by &c.; रथाः सर्वे चतुर्युजः Mb.12.29. 66.
Furnished or filled with, possessed of.
Exciting, setting on.
Even, not odd. युक्षु कुर्वन् दिनर्क्षेषु सर्वान् कामान् समश्नुते Ms.3.277; कामानुकूलानयुजो युजश्च Mb.3.34. 5. -m.
A joiner, one who unites or joins.
A sage, one who devotes himself to abstract meditation.
A pair, couple (n. also in this sense). -m. dual.
The sign Gemini of the zodiac.
The two Aśvins.
युज्य [yujya], a. Ved.
Connected, united.
Related to.
Proper, fit, suitable.
Of the same class or kind. -ज्यः A kinsman.
ज्यम् Union, connection.
Relationship.
